title: Benchmark
description: Output of evals:aggregate. The before/after comparison across the two conditions, with per-condition grading stats, per-assertion binary pass or sampled vote counts, the a-b delta, and validity warnings. Lives at <workspace>/iteration-N/benchmark.json.

baseline.description: Baseline label for revision mode; omitted otherwise.

run_summary.description: Per-condition rollup, keyed by condition name.

assertions.description: Observed substantive assertion results, keyed by eval id, assertion id, then condition. Binary assertions carry passed/n; sampled assertions carry pooled votes, run count, samples per run, and pass^k. Omitted from historical benchmarks generated before this rollup was available.

codebases.description: Codebases the compared conditions ran against, echoed from conditions.json. Absent only in historical benchmarks that predate codebase provenance.

skill_source.description: The skill under test, echoed from conditions.json. Absent for a benchmark written before skills were sourced.

diff_scope.description: Raw final-environment diff metrics per condition, ordered by eval id and then run index. Omitted for iterations created before diff-scope capture.

vote_proportion.description: Condition A mean vote proportion minus condition B mean vote proportion.

pass_power_k.description: Condition A mean pass^k minus condition B mean pass^k.

kind.description: Whether the codebase came from a repository URL or a directory on the host that ran it.

source.description: The url or path exactly as declared in evals.json.

resolved_path.description: Absolute directory a path source resolved to on the host that ran it.

ref.description: Declared branch, tag, or commit SHA, for a git source.

revision.description: The commit the run actually ran against. A declared ref does not identify this on its own, because a branch moves. Absent only for a directory carrying no history.

origin_url.description: The source repository's origin. For a host-local path this is the only handle another reader can resolve: origin_url plus revision names the same tree anywhere.

branch.description: Branch the task environment was checked out on.

host_local.description: True when the source cannot be resolved off the host that ran it, so a published claim citing it is not reproducible from the eval config alone.

exclude_skill_sources.description: Whether project-local skill roots discoverable by the selected harness were removed from the comparison environment before staging.

evals.description: Ids of the evals whose environments were built from this codebase.

dirty.description: True when the copy this record describes carries uncommitted work from its source, so revision alone does not name what ran. A codebase is checked out at a commit and is never dirty; a skill is copied as it sits on disk and can be.

kind.description: How the skill was named. A skill is named by a path on the host that ran it.

source.description: The skill directory exactly as it was resolved from.

resolved_path.description: Absolute skill directory on the host that ran it. This is the pointer promote-baseline writes its baseline back through.

ref.description: Declared ref, for a source named by one.

revision.description: The commit of the repository holding the skill. Absent when the skill is in no repository.

origin_url.description: The skill repository's origin. For a host-local path this is the only handle another reader can resolve: origin_url plus revision names the same tree anywhere.

branch.description: Branch the skill repository was on.

host_local.description: True when the skill cannot be resolved off the host that ran it, so a published claim citing it is not reproducible from a path alone.

dirty.description: True when the copy this record describes carries uncommitted work from its source, so revision alone does not name what ran. A codebase is checked out at a commit and is never dirty; a skill is copied as it sits on disk and can be.

siblings.description: Sibling skills staged alongside the skill under test, as the roster was captured at resolution.

eval_owner.description: CLI-selected skill that owns the eval definitions and workspace namespace. Present for multi-skill treatments.

skills.description: Ordered resolved source and revision for every multi-skill treatment member.

n.description: Number of observed assertion results in this cell.

pass_power_k.description: Pooled vote proportion raised to samples_per_run.

proportion.description: Passed votes divided by total votes across all runs in this cell.

mean.description: Mean of the available samples; retained as numeric 0 when n is 0 for compatibility.

stddev.description: Population standard deviation of the available samples; retained as numeric 0 when n is 0.

n.description: Number of available samples. For timing metrics, 0 means unavailable, not a measured zero.

vote_proportion.description: Per-run equal-weight mean of substantive assertion vote proportions; present when the campaign contains sampled grading.

pass_power_k.description: Per-run equal-weight mean of substantive assertion pass^k values; present when the campaign contains sampled grading.

skill_invocations.description: Per-treatment-member invocation counts and rates for multi-skill evals.
